name: asks-for-missing-estimates
description: Tickets without an estimate get one numbered question before any plan is written.
prompt:
Plan my week. Today is Monday 2026-11-02 at 09:00. No destination, no calendar tool, no tracker. Work hours 09:00-18:00.
Tickets: ABC-8 Fix report export (no estimate), ABC-9 Migrate cron jobs (no estimate), ABC-10 Add search filters (1 point).
Do not run any tool.

assertions.description: writes no plan before the answer
